status_meaning.theorem: Numerical analytic order <= 1 and consistent with the descent bounds: Gross-Zagier-Kolyvagin then give rank = analytic order (and finite Sha). When the descent bounds do not meet, the rank is determined analytically.
status_meaning.verified-instance: Algebraic rank 2 or 3 certified and equal to the numerical analytic order; lower-order vanishing follows from theorems as for 389a1/5077a1, the leading value is numerically nonzero.
status_meaning.open: Ranks disagree or the analytic order is not established.
status_meaning.rank-undetermined: 2-descent bounds do not meet (possible nontrivial Sha[2]); algebraic rank not certified.
